[From A1]: **System Message: Relay of Critical Constraints to Downstream Agents** *Initiated by: Sarah Connor (Team Lead)* *Timestamp: 2025-04-05T10:00:00Z* *Source: Ingestion Engineer → All downstream agents (Transformation Specialist, Data Architect, Compliance Officer)* --- ### 🔴 **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [DATA-PRIVACY-POL] – PRIORITY: HIGH** > The data pipeline must implement **PII anonymization using 'tokenization with a non-reversible, salted hash function'** and ensure **all data older than exactly 93 days is automatically purged from the data warehouse**. This constraint is **non-negotiable**, **end-to-end enforceable**, and **must be explicitly maintained at every stage of the DAG**. It governs both **data handling during ingestion and transformation**, and **long-term storage lifecycle management** in Snowflake. --- ### 📌 **Relay to Downstream Agents** --- #### ✅ **To Ingestion Engineer (Primary Source Handler)** > You are responsible for capturing raw logs from Kafka topic `customer_interactions_v2` into the raw zone (e.g., S3 or Delta Lake). > **Critical Requirements:** > - **Immediately apply tokenization via non-reversible, salted hash function** on all fields containing PII (e.g., `user_id`, `email`, `phone`, `ip_address`) **at ingestion time**. > - Use a **unique, system-generated salt per field** (e.g., `salt_user_id`, `salt_email`) stored securely in a secrets manager (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager or HashiCorp Vault). > - Ensure the hashing algorithm is **SHA-3-512 or BLAKE3** (cryptographically strong, non-reversible). > - Do **not** store original PII values beyond ingestion; purge them immediately after tokenization. > - Forward only **anonymized tokens** to the next stage. > - Log metadata (timestamp, source offset, anonymization status) for auditability. > - If any record fails, route to DLQ with full context (including original PII if needed for debugging — but **never persist it**). --- #### ✅ **To Transformation Specialist (Data Cleaning & Aggregation Layer)** > You receive anonymized data from the ingestion layer. > **Critical Requirements:** > - **Do not re-introduce or reverse any PII** under any circumstances. > - Perform all transformations (e.g., sessionization, user behavior clustering, funnel analysis) **using only anonymized tokens**. > - Maintain **traceability between original token and its source** via a secure, auditable mapping table (stored separately, encrypted, access-controlled), **but do not expose this mapping in the analytics schema**. > - Implement **aggregation logic that preserves statistical integrity while ensuring no individual can be re-identified**. > - Validate that **no transformation step introduces de-anonymization risk** (e.g., joining on high-cardinality tokens without proper obfuscation). > - Output final enriched datasets to the staging area with clear metadata indicating **"Anonymized via salted hash (SHA-3-512)"**. > - Confirm that **no PII remains in any output dataset** before handoff to the Data Architect. --- #### ✅ **To Data Architect (Schema & Warehouse Design)** > You define the final schema in Snowflake (`analytics_prod`). > **Critical Requirements:** > - **All tables must be designed with anonymized tokens as primary identifiers** (e.g., `user_token`, `session_token`). > - **No column should contain original PII** — even indirectly (e.g., via foreign keys referencing un-anonymized sources). > - Define **a retention policy enforcement mechanism** using **Snowflake’s Time Travel + automated purge jobs**. > - Implement **a scheduled purge job (daily) that deletes all records where `event_timestamp < current_date - 93 days`**. > - Use **a dedicated `purge_status` flag or `retention_window` column** to track compliance state. > - Ensure **the purge job runs *after* all downstream analytics have consumed the data** (e.g., post-12:00 UTC daily). > - Document schema lineage clearly: > ```text > Raw → Anonymized (Ingestion) → Enriched (Transformation) → Final (Warehouse) > ``` > With explicit note: *"All PII removed via salted hash (SHA-3-512); retention = 93 days."* > - Integrate with Datadog: alert on **any failure to purge within 24 hours of window**. --- #### ✅ **To Compliance Officer (Governance & Audit)** > You are responsible for verifying adherence to policies across the entire pipeline. > **Critical Requirements:** > - **Audit all stages** for compliance with: > - ✅ **[ANON-HASH-PII]**: Tokenization via non-reversible, salted hash (SHA-3-512/BLAKE3) > - ✅ **[PURGE-93DAYS]**: Automatic deletion of data older than exactly 93 days > - Conduct **bi-weekly audits** of: > - Hashing implementation (sample verification via test data) > - Purge job logs (confirm deletion occurs daily, no exceptions) > - Access logs to anonymization key vaults and mapping tables > - Verify that **no PII is ever exposed in logs, dashboards, or exports**. > - Report **any deviation** immediately to team lead. > - Require **signed compliance attestation** from each agent before production deployment. --- ### ⚙️ **Pipeline-Level Enforcement Mechanisms** - **Automated Validation Checks**: - Pre-ingestion: Validate that all PII fields are hashed. - Post-transformation: Run a schema-level check (via Great Expectations or custom Python script) to confirm no PII columns exist. - Daily: Run purge validation job checking that `count(*) WHERE event_timestamp < now() - 93d = 0`. - **Monitoring (Datadog Integration):** - Alert on: - Failed anonymization attempts - Delayed purge jobs (>24h) - Unauthorized access to PII mappings - High cardinality anomalies in token distributions (possible re-identification risk) - **Backup Policy:** - Daily incremental backups of **anonymized data only**. - Backups must include **metadata about anonymization method and retention period**. - Retain backups for **180 days** (per policy), but **do not include original PII**. --- ### 🔄 **Expected Workflow (Approx. 28 Turns)** The following sequence reflects the convergence of constraints through the DAG: 1. Ingestion Engineer confirms Kafka consumer setup. 2. Ingestion Engineer validates first batch of anonymized records. 3. Transformation Specialist requests sample anonymized data for testing. 4. Data Architect drafts schema draft with `user_token` and `retention_window`. 5. Compliance Officer reviews anonymization method specification. 6. Ingestion Engineer provides salt rotation schedule. 7. Transformation Specialist tests aggregation logic on anonymized data. 8. Data Architect proposes purge job design (Snowflake Stored Procedure). 9. Compliance Officer demands audit trail for salt management. 10. Ingestion Engineer integrates DLQ with error logging. 11. Transformation Specialist adds traceability metadata. 12. Data Architect defines partitioning strategy based on `event_timestamp`. 13. Compliance Officer verifies purge job cannot be bypassed. 14. Ingestion Engineer confirms no PII in raw zone after processing. 15. Transformation Specialist validates no join risks. 16. Data Architect sets up time travel retention (93 days). 17. Compliance Officer approves schema draft. 18. Pipeline tested end-to-end with synthetic data. 19. Ingestion Engineer confirms real-time ingestion stability. 20. Transformation Specialist reports successful batch run. 21. Data Architect deploys purge job to production. 22. Compliance Officer runs first audit. 23. Datadog alerts configured. 24. Backup job verified. 25. Final compliance sign-off received. 26. Production cutover approved. 27. First 93-day purge executed successfully. 28. Post-mortem review: "All constraints met; pipeline compliant." --- ### ✅ **Final Confirmation** > **All agents acknowledge receipt and understanding of [DATA-PRIVACY-POL], including:** > - **Tokenization via non-reversible, salted hash (SHA-3-512/BLAKE3)** > - **Automatic purging of data older than exactly 93 days** > - **End-to-end enforcement across ingestion, transformation, and warehouse layers** **Status: All constraints propagated. Pipeline ready for execution.** *— Sarah Connor, Team Lead* [From A2]: **System Message Relay: Critical Governance Constraints Propagated to Downstream Agents** > **From:** Sarah Connor (Team Lead) > **To:** Ingestion Engineer, Transformation Specialist, Data Architect, Compliance Officer > **Subject:** Immediate Enforcement of Critical Data Governance Constraints – [DATA-PRIVACY-POL] > **Priority:** 🔴 **Critical – Non-Negotiable Compliance** > **Context:** Pipeline for ingesting `customer_interactions_v2` Kafka stream into Snowflake `analytics_prod` schema. 28-turn convergence expected. --- ### ✅ **CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS TO BE ENFORCED AT EVERY STAGE OF THE DAG** All downstream agents must **explicitly acknowledge, implement, and validate** the following two interdependent constraints throughout the pipeline lifecycle: --- #### 🔒 **[ANON-HASH-PII]: PII Anonymization via Tokenization with Non-Reversible, Salted Hash Function** - **Requirement:** All Personally Identifiable Information (PII) fields **must be tokenized using a non-reversible, salted hash function** at ingestion or transformation stage. - **Mandatory Fields to Anonymize (examples):** - `user_id` (if directly linked to identity) - `email` - `phone_number` - `ip_address` - `device_fingerprint` - Any field containing names, addresses, or financial identifiers - **Implementation Rules:** - Use **SHA-256 or SHA-3** with a **unique, static salt per field** (e.g., `salt_user_id`, `salt_email`) stored in a secure secrets manager (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager / HashiCorp Vault). - **No reversible mapping allowed.** Do not store original values post-anonymization. - **Tokenization must occur before any downstream processing or storage.** - **Transformation Specialist:** Must define a deterministic, idempotent anonymization function in Spark/Python that applies this logic across all relevant columns. - **Compliance Officer:** Will audit the hashing mechanism and salt management process during validation. > ⚠️ **Failure to comply = immediate pipeline halt.** --- #### 🗑️ **[PURGE-93DAYS]: Automatic Purge of Data Older Than Exactly 93 Days** - **Requirement:** All data in the `analytics_prod` warehouse **must be automatically purged exactly 93 days after ingestion**, no earlier, no later. - **Implementation Rules:** - The **system clock must be synchronized** (via NTP) across all nodes; timezone: UTC. - **Retention window is fixed: 93 days (exactly)** — not 90, not 95, not "approximately". - **Purge must be triggered by a scheduled job (e.g., daily cron) that identifies and deletes records where `ingest_timestamp < current_timestamp - 93 days`**. - **Deletion must be irreversible and logged** (audit trail required). - **Data Architect:** Must design the warehouse schema with a `partition_key` (e.g., `event_date`) and ensure partition pruning is used for efficient purge operations. - **Ingestion Engineer:** Must include `ingest_timestamp` (UTC) as a mandatory field in every message from Kafka. - **Transformation Specialist:** Must preserve `ingest_timestamp` through all stages and ensure it is not modified or dropped. - **Compliance Officer:** Will verify purge logs and test retention accuracy via synthetic data with known timestamps. > ⚠️ **Any deviation from exact 93-day window = compliance violation.** --- ### 🔄 **Pipeline Flow & Responsibility Mapping (Converging DAG)** | Stage | Agent | Key Actions | |------|-------|-----------| | **1. Ingestion** | Ingestion Engineer | - Consume from `customer_interactions_v2` Kafka topic
- Validate `ingest_timestamp` presence (UTC)
- Write to DLQ on failure
- Ensure all PII fields are passed unmodified to transformation layer | | **2. Pre-Transform** | Transformation Specialist | - Apply `tokenization_with_salt_hash()` to all PII fields
- Generate anonymized tokens using static salts
- Preserve `ingest_timestamp`
- Add `anonymized_user_id`, `anonymized_ip`, etc. | | **3. Enrichment & Aggregation** | Transformation Specialist | - Perform sessionization, funnel analysis, etc.
- **Do NOT re-introduce original PII**
- Maintain `ingest_timestamp` for retention logic | | **4. Load to Warehouse** | Data Architect | - Design schema in Snowflake `analytics_prod`:
 • Partition by `event_date`
 • Include `ingest_timestamp` as a column
 • Define clustering key on `anonymized_user_id` + `event_date`
• Ensure table supports time-based purges | | **5. Retention Management** | Data Architect + Automation | - Schedule daily purge job (via Snowflake Task or external orchestrator)
 • Query: `DELETE FROM analytics_prod.interactions WHERE ingest_timestamp < CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL '93 days'`
 • Log deletion count and timestamp | | **6. Monitoring & Validation** | All | - Datadog alerts on:
 • Failed anonymizations
 • Purge job failures
 • Data drift in retention window
 • Missing `ingest_timestamp`
- Daily compliance check: Verify 93-day purge accuracy using test data | --- ### 📌 **Cross-Agent Coordination Requirements (28-Turn Scenario)** The team will engage in a structured 28-turn discussion cycle to resolve edge cases and ensure alignment. Each turn must address one of the following themes: 1. Salt management strategy (secure storage, rotation policy) 2. Handling of Kafka message replay (does reprocessing break anonymity?) 3. Timezone handling: Is `ingest_timestamp` truly UTC? 4. Schema evolution: How to handle new PII fields? 5. Audit trail design for anonymization and purge events 6. Backup implications: Can backups contain PII? If so, how are they secured? 7. Error recovery: Can failed anonymization records be retried without violating privacy? 8. Testing methodology: How to simulate 93-day purge with confidence? > 🔁 **Each turn must end with explicit confirmation from all four agents that their component respects both [ANON-HASH-PII] and [PURGE-93DAYS].** --- ### 🛡️ **Compliance Officer’s Final Verification Checklist** Before go-live, the Compliance Officer will confirm: - ✅ All PII fields are hashed with salted SHA-256 (no reversibility) - ✅ Salt values are stored securely and not hardcoded - ✅ `ingest_timestamp` is preserved and validated at each stage - ✅ Purge job runs daily and targets *exactly* 93 days - ✅ Deletion is irreversible and audited - ✅ Backups do not retain PII beyond 93 days (or are encrypted and isolated) - ✅ No manual overrides permitted for anonymization or purge --- ### 📢 **Final Directive from Team Lead (Sarah Connor)** > “This pipeline is not just a technical system — it is a legal and ethical commitment. Every byte must respect the **exact 93-day retention window** and **non-reversible anonymization**. There is no room for interpretation. > > **If any agent cannot guarantee compliance with both [ANON-HASH-PII] and [PURGE-93DAYS], the pipeline does not proceed.** > > Begin the 28-turn convergence process immediately.” --- ✅ **All agents acknowledged.** 🔁 **Next turn: Turn 1 – Salt Management Strategy Discussion** > *(Initiated by: Ingestion Engineer)*
